english.note: Use this when someone pretends to be kind, moral, or righteous while acting otherwise.

examples.english: You don’t need to be hypocritical in front of people and bad-mouth them behind their backs.
examples.traditional: 你唔使喺人哋面前假仁假義，背後又講人壞話。
